thoughts: The current Triptych layout is functional but standard, lacking the 'architectural gravitas' implied by terms like 'Infrastructure' and 'Proven Stack.' To increase conversion, I am evolving the grid into a structured 'BLUEPRINT' aesthetic. This involves adding technical detailing (line-work, grid backgrounds, and architectural callouts) to make the offer feel engineered rather than just sold. We are also integrating Evidence Items directly into the grid flow to satisfy the high dwell-time users who are clearly scrutinizing the details. The center-alignment is preserved in the header to ensure a smooth transition from the hero section, while the pricing tiers now feature 'Technical Specifications' instead of just bullet points.
